description: Look up an organisation that gave to super PACs or hybrid PACs in the Super PAC Donors Register by name substring, matched against the reviewed name, every name as filed and the reviewed company family, optionally for one FEC cycle (2026 for 2025-26, or 2024 for 2023-24; both when omitted, never added across cycles). Returns up to 5 named organisations, each with its reviewed class and status, its company family and sector, and the parent or group record from an SEC filing where the register cites one; and by cycle, its contributions by recipient super PAC as the FEC lists it, with the committee id, refunds kept apart and never netted, dates as filed and the FEC bulk file date. Beside them, never added or put in sequence: for the company families in the register's side-by-side table, the connected PAC's contributions to federal candidates' committees with its all-committees summary line (FEC), contract obligations by fiscal year (USAspending) and LDA filing counts; the organisation's net donation to the 2025 inaugural committee where it is on both records (Form 13); and ICE and CBP contract obligations for Pay-to-Play Register contractors. An empty column is a search result, not a fact about the organisation. The word nonprofit appears only on a record an exact IRS Exempt Organizations match carries, shown with that record; other issue and social-welfare groups read organisation (status not matched). Super PACs and hybrid PACs are named exactly as the FEC committee master lists them, with their committee ids and no party or candidate label; a contribution to a super PAC is not a contribution to a candidate. Every answer carries the register's question note: these records show contributions reported to the FEC; they do not show what any donor received or intended, and they do not show cause and effect. Individual donors are counted, never named; withheld strings (trusts, holding vehicles, businesses named for a person, names resting on initials, unmatched committees) and unreviewed strings appear only as counts and amounts. A name that matches only a withheld or unreviewed string answers exactly like a name that matches nothing. Every answer quotes the FEC's restriction on the sale or use of individual contributor information (52 U.S.C. 30111(a)(4)) and the FEC bulk file date; the bulk file lags the committees' latest reports.

cycle.description: Optional FEC cycle: 2026 (2025-26) or 2024 (2023-24); both when omitted, never added.

name.description: Required case-insensitive organisation or company family name substring, at most 80 characters; named donors only.

name: super_pac_donors_donor
title: Find Organisation Super PAC Donors
